subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo / technical deep dive
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo / technical deep dive

Hi Taylor,

Thanks again for taking the time today  really appreciated the overview of Acme Cloud's priorities around reducing inference cost and improving tail latency for your summarization pipeline. Quick recap from our call:

- Primary goal: reduce per-request cost while keeping 95th percentile latency under 300ms for short summaries (~512 tokens).
- Constraints: data residency for EU-based customers, internal SSO required for admin UI, and a 6-month procurement timeline.

Next step: we'd like to run a technical deep dive / demo with your infra and ML team to walk through: runtime performance, routing/fallback policies, and a short proof-of-concept plan. Could you confirm who from your side should join (ML engineer + infra recommended)?

Proposed slots (Pacific time):
- Wed Nov 18, 10:00 - 11:00 PT
- Wed Nov 18, 14:00 - 15:00 PT
- Thu Nov 19, 09:00 - 10:00 PT

If none of those work, let me know a couple of alternatives and we can adapt. Also let me know if you prefer Zoom or Google Meet  happy to send a calendar invite with the correct provider.

I'll attach our short demo deck for context.

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf

From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@acme-cloud.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@acme-cloud.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 18:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: scheduling demo / technical deep dive

Thanks Rafael  good summary.

We can do the demo. Jordan (ML lead) and I will join; we also want our infra lead (Sanjay) on the call to confirm network/KMS constraints.

Prefer morning PT if possible. Of your proposed slots, Wed Nov 18 10:00 PT works best for us.

Zoom is preferred. Please include Jordan and Sanjay (sanjay.khan@acme-cloud.com) on the invite.

A quick ask for the deep dive: could you include a short section on how Redwood handles KV cache warm-up and a demo of rollbacks/canary behavior? That will help us validate for our SLOs.

Appreciate it  Taylor
Taylor Nguyen
Product Manager, Acme Cloud
